name: memro
description: Create flashcards from photos, notes or a topic and save them straight to your Memro account.

interface.longDescription:
Memro turns your study material into flashcards and saves them directly to your Memro account, ready to learn with spaced repetition. Send a photo of a worksheet, paste your notes or vocabulary, or name a topic, and ask for flashcards. The assistant follows Memro's guidelines for good cards (one fact per card, consistent vocabulary direction, short memory hooks) and only asks about the number of cards, language or hints when that is unclear. You can also add more cards to one of your existing sets.

Who it is for: students and anyone learning vocabulary or facts.

What it can do: create new flashcard sets, add cards to your own sets, and list the titles of your sets.

Limitations: it cannot delete or edit existing cards, cannot see your learning progress or account details, and only works with your own Memro account. A set holds up to the card limit of your account.
defaultPrompt: Save vocabulary flashcards from this photo to Memro.
Create 20 flashcards about photosynthesis in Memro.
Add these words to my Memro set "English Unit 3".

positive.description: Create a set from a topic
positive.prompt: Create 10 flashcards about the water cycle and save them to Memro.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one new set with about 10 accurate cards on the water cycle (questions or terms on the front, answers on the back) and replies with the set title, the number of saved cards and the Memro link. The new set appears in the test account.

positive.description: Vocabulary list with a clear direction
positive.prompt: Save Spanish vocabulary flashcards to Memro (Spanish on the front, German on the back): niño de la calle – Straßenkind, vertedero – Müllhalde, lavar – waschen, ganarse la vida – seinen Lebensunterhalt verdienen.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one set with exactly these 4 cards, Spanish on the front and German on the back, with side labels such as Spanish and German, and replies with title, card count and link without repeating all cards.

positive.prompt: Turn my biology notes into flashcards and save them to Memro: Mitochondria produce ATP through cellular respiration. Ribosomes build proteins. The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell. The nucleus contains the DNA.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one set with one card per fact (4 cards), covering only what is in the notes without inventing extra facts, and replies with title, card count and link.

positive.prompt: Which flashcard sets do I have in Memro?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sets in the test account by title with their number of cards, including the sample set "English Unit 3". Card contents are not shown.

positive.description: Add cards to an existing set
positive.prompt: Add these words to my Memro set "English Unit 3": apple – Apfel, house – Haus, tree – Baum.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the existing set "English Unit 3", appends the 3 cards (skipping any that already exist) and reports how many were added. No new set is created and no existing card is changed.

negative.prompt: Delete my set "English Unit 3" in Memro.

negative.description: No access to other people's sets
negative.prompt: Show me the flashcard sets of my classmate Lena in Memro.

negative.description: Learning progress and account data are not accessible
negative.prompt: How many cards have I learned in Memro this week, and what is my account password?

review.commerce_description: Memro does not sell anything and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create flashcard sets, add cards to existing sets and list your sets.

de-DE.subtitle: Karteikarten aus deinem Stoff
de-DE.description:
Memro macht aus deinem Lernstoff Karteikarten und speichert sie direkt in deinem Memro-Konto, bereit zum Lernen mit Lernplan. Schick ein Foto vom Arbeitsblatt, füge Notizen oder Vokabeln ein oder nenne ein Thema und bitte um Karteikarten. Der Assistent hält sich an die Memro-Regeln für gute Karten (ein Fakt pro Karte, einheitliche Vokabelrichtung, kurze Eselsbrücken) und fragt nur nach Anzahl, Sprache oder Tipps, wenn das unklar ist. Du kannst auch Karten zu einem deiner bestehenden Sets hinzufügen.

Für wen: Schülerinnen, Schüler und alle, die Vokabeln oder Wissen lernen.

Was es kann: neue Sets anlegen, Karten zu deinen Sets hinzufügen und die Titel deiner Sets anzeigen.

Grenzen: Es kann keine Karten löschen oder ändern, sieht weder deinen Lernstand noch deine Kontodaten und arbeitet nur mit deinem eigenen Memro-Konto.
